subject.title: cli-backend agent runs against anthropic (claude-cli runtime) return 401 authentication_failed while identical claude invocation works in shell

question: Should maintainers require a macOS LaunchAgent/service-context Claude CLI OAuth reproduction before changing the managed `claude-cli` auth, env, or MCP path for this issue?
rationale: The source path matches the reporter's trace, but the failing condition depends on live Claude CLI OAuth, launchd service context, loopback MCP, and local credential/keychain state that this read-only review cannot prove from source alone.

options.title: Require service-context proof
options.body: Run a maintainer-controlled macOS LaunchAgent comparison before changing Claude CLI auth, env, or MCP behavior.

options.title: Patch from reporter trace
options.body: Sponsor a targeted backend/auth fix from the detailed wrapper trace, accepting higher regression risk because the exact live trigger remains unproven.

options.title: Scope overlap to reauth copy
options.body: Treat only the expired-token reauth-copy overlap as owned by the open related PRs and leave this managed-only 401 open for separate proof.

recommendation.title: Require service-context proof
recommendation.body: Run a maintainer-controlled macOS LaunchAgent comparison before changing Claude CLI auth, env, or MCP behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Anthropic CLI auth/runtime history is the strongest routing signal for deciding the proof bar before changing this provider path.
